title: Calvin Harris Sets First-Ever Headline Tour of Australia
summary: The superstar Scottish DJ and producer will go coast-to-coast for a four-city trek in February 2027, his first in these parts as the main man.
contentText:
Calvin Harris will return to Australia early next year for his first-ever headline tour.

The superstar Scottish DJ and producer will go coast-to-coast for a four-city trek next February, his first in these parts as the main man.

Presented by Untitled Group, Full Circle and Live Nation, Calvin Harris – Australia Tour 2027 will get Perth bouncing from Feb. 18, 2027 at Langley Park, then heads east for shows in Brisbane (RNA Showgrounds on Feb. 19), Sydney (The Domain, Feb. 20) and wraps up at Melbourne’s Flemington Racecourse (Feb. 26).

Aussie fans can expect Harris to whip out his anthems, reps say, from “One Kiss” with Dua Lipa, to “This Is What You Came For” featuring Rihanna, “Summer,” “Feel So Close,” “Sweet Nothing” featuring Florence Welch, and “Blame” featuring John Newman.

The Grammy Award-winner last visited Australia as the mainstage headliner for Festival X in late 2022, and has previously performed sets at the Stereosonic in 2011, 2012, and 2014, and the 2010 Big Day Out (Festival X, Stereosonic and BDO are no longer on the festivals calendar).

The towering EDM star (real name: Adam Wiles) boasts 11 No. 1 singles in the United Kingdom, dating back to his 2008 collaboration with Dizzee Rascal, “Dance Wiv Me.” No other dance act has more leaders on the Official U.K. Singles Chart.

His collection of career honors include two Brit Awards, an Ivor Novello Award, he owns the record for the most U.K. No. 1 singles in the 2010s (eight), and has the distinction of being the first British solo artist to pass one billion streams on Spotify.

The general public on-sale for Harris’ tour down under starts next Thursday, Sept. 24 at 1pm local time.
